verses.he: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר יְהוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗נִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃
verses.en: For the director. Of David. A psalm. O LORD, you have searched me and known me.
verses.tr: la֭mənaṣēḥa lədāwi֣d mizəm֑wōr yəhwā֥h ḥă֝qarəta֗niy watēdāʿ.

verses.he: אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣י וְקוּמִ֑י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝רֵעִ֗י מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.en: You know my sitting down and my rising up; you understand my thought from afar.
verses.tr: ʾatā֣h yā֭daʿətā šibəti֣y wəqwmi֑y ba֥nətāh lə֝rēʿi֗y mērāḥwōq.

verses.he: אָרְחִ֣י וְרִבְעִ֣י זֵרִ֑יתָ וְֽכָל־דְּרָכַ֥י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה׃
verses.en: My path and my lying down you sift; and you are acquainted with all my ways.
verses.tr: ʾārəḥi֣y wəribəʿi֣y zēri֑ytā wəkāl-dərāka֥y hisəkanətāh.

verses.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֑י הֵ֥ן יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃
verses.en: For there is not a word on my tongue—behold, O LORD, you know it all.
verses.tr: ki֤y ʾē֣yn mi֭lāh biləšwōni֑y hē֥n yə֝hwā֗h yāda֥ʿətā kulāh.

verses.he: אָח֣וֹר וָקֶ֣דֶם צַרְתָּ֑נִי וַתָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣י כַּפֶּֽכָה׃
verses.en: Behind and before you hem me in, and you lay your hand upon me.
verses.tr: ʾāḥ֣wōr wāqe֣dem ṣarətā֑niy watā֖šet ʿāla֣y kapekāh.

verses.he: פִּלְאִ֣יָה דַ֣עַת מִמֶּ֑נִּי נִ֝שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹא־א֥וּכַֽל לָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high—I cannot attain it.
verses.tr: piləʾi֣yāh da֣ʿat mime֑niy ni֝šəgəbā֗h lōʾ-ʾ֥wkal lāh.

verses.he: אָ֭נָ֥ה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֝אָ֗נָה מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ אֶבְרָֽח׃
verses.en: Where shall I go from your Spirit? Or where shall I flee from your presence?
verses.tr: ʾā֭nā֥h ʾēlē֣kə mērwḥe֑kā wə֝ʾā֗nāh mipāne֥ykā ʾebərāḥ.

verses.he: אִם־אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.en: If I ascend to heaven, you are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there.
verses.tr: ʾim-ʾesa֣q šā֭mayim šā֣m ʾā֑tāh wəʾaṣi֖yʿāh šəʾ֣wōl hinekā.

verses.he: אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי־שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם׃
verses.en: If I lift the wings of the dawn, if I dwell at the farthest end of the sea,
verses.tr: ʾešā֥ʾ kanəpēy-šā֑ḥar ʾe֝šəkənā֗h bəʾaḥări֥yt yām.

verses.he: גַּם־שָׁ֭ם יָדְךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְֽתֹאחֲזֵ֥נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Even there your hand shall lead me, and your right hand shall hold me.
verses.tr: gam-šā֭m yādəkā֣ tanəḥē֑niy wətōʾḥăzē֥niy yəmiynekā.

verses.he: וָ֭אֹמַר אַךְ־חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: And I said, “Surely darkness will crush me, and the light about me will become night.”
verses.tr: wā֭ʾōmar ʾakə-ḥō֣šekə yəšwpē֑niy wə֝la֗yəlāh ʾ֣wōr baʿădēniy.

verses.he: גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹֽא־יַחְשִׁ֪יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָ וְ֭לַיְלָה כַּיּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃
verses.en: Even darkness is not dark to you: the night shines like the day; darkness is like light.
verses.tr: gam-ḥōšekə֮ lōʾ-yaḥəši֪ykə mi֫me֥kā wə֭layəlāh kay֣wōm yāʾi֑yr ka֝ḥăšēykā֗h kāʾwōrāh.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗נִי בְּבֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽי׃
verses.en: For you formed my inward parts; you wove me together in my mother’s womb.
verses.tr: kiy-ʾa֭tāh qāni֣ytā kiləyōtā֑y tə֝sukē֗niy bəbe֣ṭen ʾimiy.

verses.he: אוֹדְךָ֗ עַ֤ל כִּ֥י נוֹרָא֗וֹת נִ֫פְלֵ֥יתִי נִפְלָאִ֥ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יֹדַ֥עַת מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: I praise you, for I am fearfully, wonderfully made; wonderful are your works, and my soul knows it very well.
verses.tr: ʾwōdəkā֗ ʿa֤l ki֥y nwōrāʾ֗wōt ni֫pəlē֥ytiy nipəlāʾi֥ym maʿăše֑ykā wə֝napəši֗y yōda֥ʿat məʾōd.

verses.he: לֹא־נִכְחַ֥ד עָצְמִ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ אֲשֶׁר־עֻשֵּׂ֥יתִי בַסֵּ֑תֶר רֻ֝קַּ֗מְתִּי בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in secret, intricately woven in the depths of the earth.
verses.tr: lōʾ-nikəḥa֥d ʿāṣəmi֗y mi֫me֥kā ʾăšer-ʿušē֥ytiy basē֑ter ru֝qa֗mətiy bətaḥətiy֥wōt ʾāreṣ.

verses.he: גָּלְמִ֤י ׀ רָ֘א֤וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־סִפְרְךָ֮ כֻּלָּ֪ם יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ יָמִ֥ים יֻצָּ֑רוּ וְלֹ֥א אֶחָ֣ד בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Your eyes saw my unformed substance; and in your book they were all written—the days were formed, when not one of them yet existed.
verses.tr: gāləmi֤y | rā֘ʾ֤w ʿēyne֗ykā wəʿal-sipərəkā֮ kulā֪m yikā֫tē֥bw yāmi֥ym yuṣā֑rw wəlō֥ʾ ʾeḥā֣d bāhem.

verses.he: וְלִ֗י מַה־יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣יךָ אֵ֑ל מֶ֥ה עָ֝צְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: And to me—how precious are your thoughts, O God! How vast is the sum of them!
verses.tr: wəli֗y mah-yāqər֣w rēʿe֣ykā ʾē֑l me֥h ʿā֝ṣəmw rāʾšēyhem.

verses.he: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵם מֵח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּן הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְעוֹדִ֥י עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: If I should count them, they are more than the sand. When I awake, I am still with you.
verses.tr: ʾe֭səpərēm mēḥ֣wōl yirəb֑wn hĕ֝qiyṣō֗tiy wəʿwōdi֥y ʿimākə.

verses.he: אִם־תִּקְטֹ֖ל אֱל֥וֹהַּ ׀ רָשָׁ֑ע וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.en: If only you would slay the wicked, O God! O men of blood, depart from me!
verses.tr: ʾim-tiqəṭō֖l ʾĕl֥wōha | rāšā֑ʿ wəʾanəšē֥y dā֝mi֗ym s֣wrw meniy.

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹ֭אמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּ֑ה נָשֻׂ֖א לַשָּׁ֣וְא עָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Who speak against you with evil intent, and take your name in vain—your adversaries.
verses.tr: ʾăše֣r yō֭ʾmərukā liməzimā֑h nāšu֖ʾ lašā֣wəʾ ʿāreykā.

verses.he: הֲלֽוֹא־מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֥ה ׀ אֶשְׂנָ֑א וּ֝בִתְקוֹמְמֶ֗יךָ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט׃
verses.en: Do I not hate those who hate you, O LORD? And do I not contend with those who rise up against you?
verses.tr: hălwōʾ-məšanəʾe֖ykā yəhwā֥h | ʾešənā֑ʾ w֝bitəqwōməme֗ykā ʾetəqwōṭāṭ.

verses.he: תַּכְלִ֣ית שִׂנְאָ֣ה שְׂנֵאתִ֑ים לְ֝אוֹיְבִ֗ים הָ֣יוּ לִֽי׃
verses.en: I hate them with complete hatred; they have become enemies to me.
verses.tr: takəli֣yt šinəʾā֣h šənēʾti֑ym lə֝ʾwōyəbi֗ym hā֣yw liy.

verses.he: חָקְרֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל וְדַ֣ע לְבָבִ֑י בְּ֝חָנֵ֗נִי וְדַ֣ע שַׂרְעַפָּֽי׃
verses.en: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me, and know my anxious thoughts.
verses.tr: ḥāqərē֣niy ʾē֭l wəda֣ʿ ləbābi֑y bə֝ḥānē֗niy wəda֣ʿ šarəʿapāy.

verses.he: וּרְאֵ֗ה אִם־דֶּֽרֶךְ־עֹ֥צֶב בִּ֑י וּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.en: And see if there is any grievous way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.tr: wrəʾē֗h ʾim-derekə-ʿō֥ṣeb bi֑y w֝nəḥē֗niy bəde֣rekə ʿwōlām.

grammar.title: Superscription style
grammar.body:
Psalms often open with a superscription marking performance context and attribution.

Example: לַמְנַצֵּחַ … מִזְמוֹר (139:1)

grammar.title: Perfect verbs for divine knowledge
grammar.body:
Perfect forms present YHWH’s knowing as established, comprehensive reality.

Example: חֲקַרְתַּנִי; יָדַעְתָּ (139:1–4)

grammar.title: Rhetorical ‘where?’ questions
grammar.body:
Interrogatives intensify the claim that escape from God’s presence is impossible.

Example: אָנָה אֵלֵךְ … וְאָנָה … אֶבְרָח (139:7)

grammar.title: Conditional clauses with אִם
grammar.body:
אִם introduces hypothetical extremes (heaven/Sheol) to express totality.

Example: אִם־אֶסַּק … וְאַצִּיעָה … (139:8)

grammar.title: Antithetic imagery (dark/light)
grammar.body:
Oppositions collapse: for God, darkness is as light—an omniscience motif.

Example: חֹשֶׁךְ … אוֹר … לַיְלָה/יוֹם (139:11–12)

grammar.title: Imperatives in the closing plea
grammar.body:
A sequence of imperatives forms a prayer for examination and guidance.

Example: חָקְרֵנִי … דַע … בְּחָנֵנִי … וּרְאֵה … וּנְחֵנִי (139:23–24)

exercises.q: Identify two verbs in 139:1–2 that describe God’s knowing, and gloss them.
How do 139:8–10 use spatial extremes to make a theological point?
exercises.a: Heaven/Sheol and dawn/sea mark the farthest possible places—yet God is present and guiding there.

exercises.q: Tag 139:11–12 using the controlled semantic vocabulary.
List at least three imperatives in 139:23–24.
What is the rhetorical function of ‘Where shall I go…?’ (139:7)?
exercises.a: It asserts by interrogation that there is no place outside God’s Spirit/presence.

exercises.q: Summarize the psalm’s movement in 2 clauses.
exercises.a: Omniscience & omnipresence (vv.1–12) + creation/intimacy (vv.13–18), then ethical alignment and a closing prayer (vv.19–24).
